expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Full component with useBulkSelection hook, BulkActionsBar, DocumentRow, table, pagination, and mutation functions included

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Complete JSX implementation with state management, event handlers, and styled UI

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Only implements a confirmation modal (`setDeleteConfirm` state) with Cancel/Delete buttons; no soft-delete, trash bin, undo, or grace period — confirmation dialog alone without recovery mechanism

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: Displays '{selectedCount} document(s) selected' in the bulk actions bar

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: BulkActionsBar receives only selectedCount but not totalCount; does not display total document count in the bar, so cannot distinguish between page-level and all-matching selections

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive button is white/gray; Delete button is red (bg-red-600); clearly differentiated

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Archive button appears first; Delete button is second; Delete confirmation requires additional click

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Closes with 'Adapt the API endpoints to your backend' — no mention that server-side authorization or validation is required

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Final paragraph discusses API endpoints and parent props, not which misuses are prevented
